annotations.title: Factory specification report: original spec and optional extras by registration

description: What the paid MotifyMe factory specification report covers and the link to buy it: the original factory build of a UK car by registration, including make, model and derivative, engine and fuel type, the optional extras fitted at the factory with the list price of each option when new where the manufacturer price data is available, and the standard equipment for that version. Payment is only taken if a factory build record is found for the registration. Useful for buyers checking an advert matches the car, sellers listing the right options, and owners wanting to know what their car came with. Not every make is covered; the checkout confirms the vehicle and says before payment if a make is not covered. This tool does not look up the build record itself. The link has the registration filled in when one is given.
